instructions:
Read the supplied prepared Results evidence. Return a short JSON list of applicable limits tied to exact J, C, or A aliases: price scope, cabin, traveler, separate tickets, and dated availability. Preserve unknowns. Do not recommend journeys, select a benchmark, or author the answer.

Exact-choice reading guide: each journey group's facts give the whole-journey route, full dated departure/arrival, duration, cabin and booking obligation for every member in that group. Each member's choice.award_quote and choice.cash_quote copy only its exact referenced component's reported facts; state=unknown or absent and unknown price_scope remain unknown. Never move a quote, cabin, seat or booking fact between J members. reasons_ref, cost_ref, assessments_ref and positioning_reason_ref are zero-based indexes into the same-named journey_fact_catalog arrays; use each full indexed value as the group fact. same_schedule lists all J members by matching reported route, full timestamps, duration and transfer facts. An unknown schedule is listed alone and proves no timing relationship; matching does not prove the same physical flights, price, cabin, booking or availability. Compare cabins and arrival timing separately across meaningful alternatives, especially an economy option matching a business option's schedule. Do not assume a schedule improvement is purchased by a cabin upgrade when an eligible same-schedule economy choice exists.
